summary: Charming Medical Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of independent director Matthew Mo Kan Tsui effective April 27, 2026, for other business commitments, and the appointment of Mei Cai as an independent director, effective May 2, 2026, with annual compensation of US$50,000. Ms. Cai will chair the Audit Committee and serve on Compensation and Nominating Committees. The board determined her independence and audit committee financial expertise. The resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company. This filing reports a routine board composition change, not a forced departure or strategic event, so it is classified under Management Changes with low event significance.
